strings.zh: 迷思 1：痘痘是青春期才會的事
strings.en: Myth 1: Acne only happens during puberty
Myth 2: You can just squeeze pimples and they'll go away

strings.zh: 迷思 3：油性肌的人才會長痘，乾性肌不會
strings.en: Myth 3: Only oily skin gets acne; dry skin doesn't

strings.zh: 迷思 4：多洗臉就能改善痘痘
strings.en: Myth 4: Washing your face more often will clear acne

strings.zh: 迷思 5：巧克力 / 油炸物 / 辣的食物會直接讓你長痘
strings.en: Myth 5: Chocolate / fried food / spicy food directly cause acne
Myth 6: Dabbing toothpaste on a pimple is the fastest fix

strings.zh: 迷思 7：痘痘藥膏越濃越強越快好
strings.en: Myth 7: Stronger acne creams work faster

strings.zh: 迷思 8：痘痘吃保健食品就會好
strings.en: Myth 8: Supplements alone will cure acne
Myth 9: Once the pimple is gone, you're done

strings.zh: 常見問題（PTT / Dcard 上常被問的）
strings.en: Common Questions (frequently asked on PTT / Dcard)

strings.zh: 2024 AAD 痤瘡治療指引重點(Reynolds et al., JAAD 2024)
strings.en: Key points from the 2024 AAD acne guidelines (Reynolds et al., JAAD 2024)

strings.zh: 痘痘 PTT / Dcard 上常被推薦的藥膏值得買嗎？
strings.en: Are the creams recommended on PTT / Dcard actually worth buying?

strings.zh: 痘痘多久會好？為什麼我吃藥/擦藥沒效？
strings.en: How long does acne take to clear? Why isn't my medication working?

strings.zh: 痘痘看皮膚科會開什麼藥？健保 vs 自費差別？
strings.en: What do dermatologists prescribe for acne? NHI vs out-of-pocket differences?

strings.zh: 痘痘是不是要忌口豆漿、雞蛋、巧克力？
strings.en: Do I need to avoid soy milk, eggs, or chocolate for acne?

strings.zh: 實務建議：不需要完全戒除，但若你發現某食物吃了一直冒，記下來、嘗試 4 週減量看看。減糖、少喝含糖飲料是 CP 值最高的飲食調整。
strings.en: Practical advice: You don't need to cut foods out entirely. If you notice a particular food consistently triggers breakouts, log it and try cutting back for 4 weeks. Reducing sugar and sugary drinks gives the best return on effort.

strings.zh: 痘痘平了之後留下的問題分兩種：
strings.en: Two distinct problems remain after acne clears:

strings.zh: 看到痘痘消了之後仍有凹陷，別等了，皮膚科評估會比拖延 5 年才處理輕鬆許多。
strings.en: If you still see indentations after the pimples clear, don't wait. A dermatology evaluation now is far easier than treating 5-year-old scars.

strings.zh: 健保：外用 Adapalene、BPO、克林黴素、Acnatac/Duac、口服抗生素(Doxycycline、Minocycline)、口服 A 酸（Isotretinoin，但需符合條件）。自費常見：雷射（脈衝染料、皮秒）、化學換膚、痘痘針（局部類固醇注射）、進階保養品。健保藥物已涵蓋 90% 痘痘需求，自費主要是處理痘疤或加速改善。
strings.en: Taiwan NHI: topical adapalene, BPO, clindamycin, Acnatac/Duac, oral antibiotics (doxycycline, minocycline), oral isotretinoin (with criteria). Out-of-pocket: lasers (pulsed-dye, picosecond), chemical peels, intralesional steroid injections, advanced skincare. NHI medications already cover 90% of acne needs; out-of-pocket mainly handles scar treatment or accelerates improvement.

strings.zh: 美國皮膚科醫學會 2024 年最新版痤瘡治療指引(取代 2016 版),共 18 條實證建議 + 5 條最佳實踐:
strings.en: The American Academy of Dermatology's 2024 acne guidelines (replacing 2016) include 18 evidence-based recommendations and 5 best-practice statements:

strings.zh: 白頭粉刺：可用消毒過的粉刺棒輕壓，不要用指甲擠
strings.en: Whiteheads: gently use a sterilized comedo extractor — never your fingernails

strings.zh: 大顆囊腫型痘痘：皮膚科可注射稀釋類固醇，24 小時內顯著消腫，不留疤
strings.en: Large cystic acne: a dermatologist can inject dilute corticosteroid, with significant flattening within 24 hours and no scarring

strings.zh: 合併不同機轉的外用藥(例如 retinoid + BPO)
strings.en: Combine topicals with different mechanisms (e.g., retinoid + BPO)

strings.zh: 限制系統性抗生素單獨使用，合併外用治療
strings.en: Limit systemic antibiotic monotherapy; combine with topicals

strings.zh: 較大囊腫考慮病灶內類固醇注射(triamcinolone)
strings.en: For larger cysts, consider intralesional triamcinolone injection

strings.zh: 口服 A 酸是唯一同時擊中所有 4 個的藥
strings.en: Oral isotretinoin is the only drug that hits all 4 mechanisms simultaneously

strings.zh: 荷爾蒙波動（月經前、停服避孕藥、多囊性卵巢）、壓力、保養品、口罩悶熱、睡眠
strings.en: Hormone fluctuations (premenstrual, stopping oral contraceptives, PCOS), stress, skincare products, mask occlusion, and sleep
One of the leading causes of scarring

strings.zh: 大部分凹疤（冰錐疤、廂型疤、滾動疤）的源頭都是「年輕時擠過的痘」
strings.en: Most atrophic scars (ice-pick, boxcar, rolling) trace back to pimples squeezed in adolescence

strings.zh: 只有第一個跟出油有關，後三個跟膚質乾濕無關
strings.en: only the first relates to sebum; the other three are independent of skin oiliness

strings.zh: 強化保濕（神經醯胺、玻尿酸）、選溫和不致粉刺的痘痘成分(adapalene、azelaic acid)、避免高濃度去角質
strings.en: Boost moisturization (ceramides, hyaluronic acid), choose gentle non-comedogenic acne actives (adapalene, azelaic acid), and avoid high-strength exfoliants

strings.zh: 乳製品與高升糖食物確實有關
strings.en: dairy and high-glycemic foods are genuinely linked

strings.zh: 高升糖指數（高 GI)飲食
乳製品（尤其低脂牛奶、乳清蛋白）
strings.en: dairy (especially low-fat milk and whey protein)

strings.zh: 更敏感、更容易爆痘 / 反黑
strings.en: more sensitive, with higher risk of breakouts and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

strings.zh: 從低濃度低頻率開始（每週 2-3 次)，適應後再升級
strings.en: Start low-strength, low-frequency (2–3 times per week) and ramp up after tolerance builds

strings.zh: 沒有任何保健食品能取代外用 / 口服處方治療
strings.en: No supplement can replace topical or oral prescription therapy

strings.zh: 痘印（發炎後色素沉澱 PIH / 發炎後紅斑 PIE)

strings.en: will not heal on their own

strings.zh: 皮膚科常用、有實證的藥膏
strings.en: evidence-based topicals commonly prescribed by dermatologists
Not enough time on the medication

strings.zh: 沒有實證需要全面忌口
strings.en: no evidence supports cutting these out entirely

strings.zh: 找對處方、規律使用、做好防曬
strings.en: the right prescription, used consistently, with proper sun protection

strings.zh: 女性出現多毛、月經不規則、雄激素禿髮、不孕、PCOS 特徵
strings.en: for women with hirsutism, menstrual irregularity, androgenetic alopecia, infertility, or PCOS features

strings.zh: 民眾最常誤會的觀念，一次澄清
strings.en: Clearing up the public's most common misunderstandings, all in one place
